en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hassan, from Ali Bin Asbaat, from Al Hakaam Bin Muskeyn, form Jameel Bin Darraj who said,

‘I said to Abu Abdullahasws, ‘Where would he be struck with the sword, the one who came to his Mahram (committed incest), where is this strike to be?’ Heasws said: ‘His neck would be struck’, or said: ‘His throat should be struck’.
